\n1. In Workable, click your profile ico:
1. In Workable, click your profile icon in the upper right and open **Settings → Integrations**.
2. In the **API Access Tokens** section, click **Generate new token**.
3. Select these scopes:
   - r_jobs
   - r_candidates
   - w_candidates
   - w_comments (optional, for Add Comment)
4. Click **Generate token** and paste it here. Workable shows the token only once.

If the token can see several Workable accounts, steps use the first one unless you fill **Account Subdomain**.

This trigger creates a Workable webhook subscription when the flow is published and removes it when the flow is turned off.

Every delivery is checked against the **X-Workable-Signature** HMAC, signed with your API access token. Deliveries without a valid signature are ignored, and Workable retries of the same event run the flow only once.
